reason: Conversation 2 gets the diagnosis right and moves forward: it uses the customer's description to point to worn bearings, asks for the drum lift test, and concludes from the clunky play that the bearings have failed. It repeats itself, never gives a straight answer on repair versus replace, and frustrates the customer; it never asks for the drum play check.
